propositions.statement: DWZ eq-4: UncAnsCEO_it = alpha + gamma_i*CEO_it + beta_s*Speech_sit + beta_k*FirmChars_kit + Year_t + epsilon_it, with ClarityCEO_i = -gamma_i and UncResCEO = epsilon_it. Speech = {UncPreCEO, UncQue, NegCall}; FirmChars = {SurpDec, EPSgrowth, StockRet, MarketRet}; plus Year fixed effects. ATTRIBUTION (advisor): this is DWZ's SPECIFICATION re-estimated on OUR sample -- the residual is our own (outputs .../ceo_clarity_residual.parquet), not DWZ's published residuals; prose must say 'DWZ's specification, estimated on our data'. If our bible control set differs from this verified set, it is a DWZ-STYLE decomposition, not literally eq-4 (this is why the Catch-3 bible cross-check is load-bearing).

propositions.statement: UncPre over-control: UncPreCEO is an eq-4 control, yet prepared-remarks uncertainty carries signal (shown in 4.2) and the UncPre->UncRes association is significant (0.0111**/0.0230**, tab:h23). Reconcile -- prepared remarks are drafted/vetted in advance and so do not carry the live-Q&A shock -- and/or show robustness to dropping UncPre, and/or disclose as a limitation.
propositions.verification_plan: Numbers bible-verbatim (claim ledger C3). Reconciliation argument = write-time. Confirm UncPre in-eq-4 from the NLM-verified control set (done, Q3).

propositions.statement: FirmChars bad-control: eq-4 nets contemporaneous performance {SurpDec, EPSgrowth, StockRet, MarketRet}. Because the acquirer's performance variables may themselves move in the pre-announcement quarter, eq-4 partials part of that out of UncRes -- so UncRes could be attenuated OR inflated relative to raw answer-uncertainty; the sign is a priori indeterminate. A drop-FirmChars robustness check (pending rerun) resolves it empirically; absent that, disclose as an open limitation.

source.note: sign = sign(beta_FirmChars) x sign(acquirer pre-announce perf move); neither known. keown1981 is about TARGET run-up, NOT acquirers -> not direct support for an acquirer-side premise.

propositions.verification_plan: Sign indeterminacy is the honest posture. drop-FirmChars check is R-class (rerun, user-authorized) -- does NOT exist yet -> GATES the claim, not an either/or. No NLM.

propositions.statement: By construction the residual is net of analyst-question uncertainty (UncQue) and call negativity (NegCall), so it mechanically pre-empts part of the analyst-scrutiny and tone confounds.
propositions.verification_plan: Rests on the NLM-verified eq-4 control set. Framing; cross-links 2.2/2.5. No new query.
